verdict.rationale: Reflect is a note-taking app with built-in AI (an AI palette, chat with notes, and a GPT-4o/Claude model toggle), so plugging external MCP servers into its AI is a fair question for this kind of product. The evidence pack contains no mention of MCP client support or any way to connect external tool servers. Its REST API, OAuth, deep links and Zapier integration are adjacent features and earn no credit toward this story.
